notes.title: Deep Rune V1.03 Update
notes.notes:
Updated Deep Rune to V1.03.

Changes include:
- Fixed some more grammatical issues.
- Added a new NPC and fast travel, which becomes available after defeating certain bosses.

notes.title: Deep Rune V1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Updated Deep Rune to V1.02.

Changes include:
- Fixed some grammatical issues.
- Several "secret" fixes.
- Reworded the description for the insightful trait to better clarify its effect.
- Insight now triggers a few "visual" changes in the world, with more to come in future updates!

notes.title: Deep Rune V1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Updated Deep Rune to V1.01.

Changes:
- The Amnesiac can no longer receive the Insightful trait.
- The Marksman trait now gives +2 ATT bonus for the bow instead of +4.
- The Agile trait formula is now normal fall damage divided by half rounded down (instead of just rounding).
- The Affluent trait now gives 80 gold instead of 100.
- The Haggler trait now reduces shop prices by 20% instead of 25%.
- The line of shrooms in the Ancient Ruins has been shifted right a bit.
- The quickload key has been rebound to F8.
- Minor graphical, lighting, and tileset fixes.
- Minor bug fixes for the Steam version.

notes.title: Deep Rune Released!
notes.notes:
The full version of Deep Rune has finally been released, enjoy your playthrough!

If you have any feedback or happen to encounter any issues, feel free to post in discussions.

notes.title: Demo Updated to V1.0
notes.notes:
The Deep Rune demo has been updated to V1.0 to match the upcoming release of the full game! Note that V1.0 save data is not compatible with save data in previous versions of the demo.

Full game releases in 2 weeks! :O
